note: Combined bone-axis diagnostic. Per-character dumps: TERERE_ACTORCORE_BONE_AXIS_AUDIT.json and JAGUARETE_ACTORCORE_BONE_AXIS_AUDIT.json.
method: +10 deg local Euler XYZ on pose bones; tail world delta recorded.

anatomical_reading.hip: local Y is bone length (tail delta 0). Local X/Z swing the pelvis.
anatomical_reading.limbs: AccuRIG CC_Base_* bones are Y-along-bone. Mixamo mapped bones share FBX Y-up convention but rest quats differ ~60–93 deg, so the same Mixamo local X is not AccuRIG local X.
anatomical_reading.implication: Copying Mixamo local rotations (rest-relative or clip-relative) does not guarantee anatomical axis correspondence. Clip-relative is used to prevent explosion, not to claim perfect Mixamo standing.
